name: Prongstrike
description: Jab the long central prong straight into the opponent's midsection from a hand held at the hip.

name: Holding Handknob
description: Lay the sai along the forearm with both tines up so the arm takes a cut on the metal.

name: Short Handknob
description: Flip the grip and rap the heavy butt-knob down onto the back of the opponent's hand.

name: Stepping Tineleft
description: Sliding the lead foot forward as the sai rises brings the guard and the body in together.

name: Angled Crossprong
description: The crossbar tines cradle an incoming stick and swing it wide of the shoulder.

name: Locking Tineleft
description: Press the tines across a wrist and pin it to the opponent's thigh until the arm goes slack.

name: Raised Sidehook
description: Raise the sai so the tines meet a downward cut and slide it off to the outside.

name: Pinioncowl
description: Catching a stick between the tines and rolling the wrist binds it against the shaft.

name: Wristblow
description: Bring the butt-knob down in a short hammer blow onto the collarbone.

name: Veedodge
description: Turn a quarter on the ball of the foot to take the body off the line of a thrust.

name: Prongcowl
description: A lift of the sai across the knuckles lets the tines shelter the hand from a falling blow.

name: Sharp Centerprong
description: Poke the tip of the central prong into the soft hollow beneath the ribs.

name: Hitching Sidehook
description: Hook a side tine over the opponent's wrist and pull the arm off its line.

name: Resting Hiltpoint
description: Rolling the sai over the thumb from forward to reverse grip sweeps a cut aside as it turns.

name: Single Twist
description: Repeat jab and rap and hook in a triangle until the hand knows each angle without looking.

name: Planted Tinecrook
description: Brace the rear heel behind the sai held crossways so the tines take the weight of a shove.

name: Firm Hiltpoint
description: Drive the hip into a short thrust so the central prong reaches past the opponent's guard.

name: Watching Tineright
description: Rest the tines against the opponent's weapon and read its push to learn where the next cut falls.

name: Fixing Tinecrook
description: Take a swinging edge between the tines and lock it before it can draw back.

name: Wrestwedge
description: Both wrists turn together so the caught blade is wrenched out of a loose grip.

name: Solid Sanguard
description: Cross the sai over the elbow line to stop a low cut before it reaches the ribs.

name: Veehit
description: Free the sai from a catch with a rap of the butt-knob across the opponent's knuckles.

name: Lowered Tineleft
description: Dropping the sai tines-down beside the shin turns a low kick or swing aside.

name: Pushing Handknob
description: Set the fork against the shoulder joint and bear down until the arm loses its swing.

name: Quick Snag
description: Jab with the lead sai and follow at once with the rear sai along the same line.

name: Hooding Tineright
description: Both sai cross at the wrists so the tines lock into an X sheltering the face.

name: Ready Centerprong
description: Turn the lead sai out to parry while the rear sai drops back to cover the ribs.

name: Hard Sidehook
description: Hook the rear sai over the opponent's raised guard and rap the butt-knob onto the brow.

name: Piniondash
description: A run of butt-knob raps from alternate hands keeps the opponent busy covering.

name: Pulling Pinion
description: Close both sai like scissors on a forearm so the tines clamp it from either side.

name: Backward Hiltpoint
description: Step back one pace with both sai raised so the guard moves as the feet move.

name: Even Hiltpoint
description: Settle into an even stance with a sai low in each hand and read the opponent's weight shift.

name: Wristlid
description: Run a little qi down the arm into the tines so a blocked cut stops without bending the sai.

name: Stiff Prongbase
description: A trickle of qi stiffens the shaft as it jabs and sets the force deeper into the target.

name: Turning Wrest
description: Keep qi circling through the wrist while the tines turn a caught blade in the opponent's hand.

name: Prongpace
description: Push off the back foot with a breath of qi so the yoke of the sai arrives first at close range.

name: Snug Prongbase
description: Slide the shaft along the incoming blade and let a little qi in the metal carry it off line.

name: Clasphit
description: Snap the butt-knob up under the jaw with the first pulse of qi carried in the forearm.

name: Tight Handknob
description: Sit into the first guard posture and let a thin film of qi hold the sai steady against a press.

name: Raised Crossprong
description: Raising the tines on a rising line makes a descending cut meet metal and slide aside.

name: Folded Sanguard
description: Drop the fork low across the lap and brace it with qi against a cut to the thigh.

name: Narrow Wrest
description: Extend the guarding hand into a short thrust so the guard ends as a point at full reach.

name: Stopping Prongbase
description: Lay the sai flat across the opponent's weapon arm and press until the arm cannot rise.

name: Wristhop
description: Retreat half a pace with the guard held so the distance opens while the sai stays up.

name: Veenote
description: Hold still in guard and let the sai tips feel the air for a cut about to land.

name: Sudden Tineleft
description: Draw the sai from the sash and jab in the same motion before the opponent can set.

name: Light Twist
description: Shifting weight from the carry stance onto the lead foot sends the sai point-first at the target.

name: Kept Hiltpoint
description: Let the sai fall from the sleeve into a hand already turned to catch a cut on the tines.

name: Towing Hiltpoint
description: Hook the opponent's belt with a side tine and tug to break the balance of a lunging step.

name: Warm Handknob
description: Hold a breath at the ready and gather a little qi in the grip so the next blow carries more.

name: Veestay
description: Turn the sai reverse so the shaft lies along the forearm and take a cut on the metal with qi behind it.

name: Settled Tineleft
description: Sweep the reverse-held shaft outward to knock a thrust off its line.

name: Level Ensnare
description: Driving the elbow forward lands the butt of the reverse-held sai on the ribs with a pulse of qi.

name: Wriststrike
description: Drop the closed fist and butt-knob together onto the top of the opponent's forearm.

name: Swaying Wrest
description: Spin on the lead foot with the sai tucked reverse and slip out of a grab.

name: Gnawing Tinecrook
description: Rake the tines down the opponent's lead arm in a long reverse pull that tears sleeve and skin.

name: Angled Sidehook
description: Flip the sai from reverse to forward overhead and cut the shaft down across an incoming blow.

name: Fouling Centerprong
description: Press the shaft behind the opponent's wrist and hold it against the forearm with steady qi.

name: Clasplid
description: Snap the tines closed around a blade with qi set in the wrists to stop it dead.

name: Snaghusk
description: A half turn of the caught sai levers the blade against the tines and breaks the opponent's grip.

name: Resting Tinecrook
description: Slip the outer tine under a cut and turn it away before it gathers force.

name: Tripping Tineright
description: Lock the blade between the tines and lift it slowly until the opponent's arm is open.

name: Blunt Crossprong
description: Release the catch by turning the sai and rap the butt-knob into the exposed ribs.

name: Judging Centerprong
description: Pause with the blade held in the tines and feel through the metal how hard the opponent pulls.
